sections.name: Machete
sections.description: THE WHOLE CHOP, all 52 cells at 30fps = 1.733s: guard (0-13), the blade lifted overhead (13-24), cocked (24-36), the coil (37-43), the strike (43-46) and the follow-through (47-51). Played whole since request 299, because the supplied swing sound (machete-swing.mp3, 1.80s) was authored to it: its 'lift' section (0.44-0.90s) is frames 13-27 and its strike peak (1.45s) is frame 43. The old section began at 30 with the blade already up, skipping the lift the sound voices. Cells 17, 37, 42 are the known magenta-fault frames and are NOT drawn: each holds the frame before it, so the list stays 52 long and the clock stays 1:1 with the sound.

sections.name: Machete Windup
sections.description: The full approach to the chop, kept as its own section so the trim above is reversible without re-reading the art. Frames 0-12 are the ready pose with the blade tucked; 13-15 whip it out behind him (his trailing edge jumps 449->507->511 in three frames); 16-29 raise it overhead. NOT CURRENTLY PLAYED by any state — the `machete` section is self-contained. Frame 17 is omitted for the same magenta fault that drops 37 and 42 above.

sections.name: Armed Idle
sections.description: His ARMED fight stance (request 302): frames 0-12, standing squared up with the blade raised — the opening of the chop before the lift starts at 13. Ping-ponged so the loop has no seam. Replaces the old 'idle' made of the ARMED HIT REACTION's last three frames (shaved-agbero-armed-hit 8-10), which looped a recoil and read as him flinching while nobody touched him. Because the chop starts on frame 0 of this same sheet, squaring up into a swing never pops.
